purpose: Exact vendored Lean-source requirement implementation used by the local preflight

contract.physical_line_count: LF-based; CRLF counts one physical line; unterminated final line counts
contract.header_comments: ordinary line/block comments accepted; doc comments are commands and do not count as header whitespace
contract.lakefile_exemption: basename lakefile.lean is exempt from module-header requirement only, not line cap
contract.symlinks: directories are not traversed; symlink .lean files are rejected
